messages.subject: lavExport() and MplusAutomation
parts:
I want to export and convert a lavaan model from lavaan to Mplus, using lavExport() and generate an mplusObject in MplusAutomation.

lavExport() gives a character vector (apart from the option to generate an Mplus input file). The challenge is that the character object generated by lavExport seems to require some detailed string programming if I want to convert it to an mplusObject for futher manipulation with MplusAutomation. 

(The motive for developing this code is that I want to be able to convert models from lavaan when I need specific features available only in Mplus.)

Apparently, I need to learn detailed string manipulation in R. Or are there easier options for converting a lavaan object to an MplusAutomation object?

Christopher Bratt
